scope: SPH retrospective development; mapped ECG statements, not independent or clinical validation

dictionary.83: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz type I (Wenckebach)
dictionary.84: Second-degree AV block, Mobitz type II

non_evaluable.NSR: SPH Normal ECG is not an explicit NSR statement and is never part of Other
non_evaluable.LQTS: prolonged QT statement 148 is not LQTS syndrome
non_evaluable.unmapped_abnormal_rhythm: not a known Other reference or known negative

reference.positive: at least one mapped target code and no Normal ECG statement
reference.ambiguous: Normal ECG co-recorded with any other primary statement or exact waveform with incompatible endpoint reference states
reference.unknown: all other references; never treated as negative

comparator: maximum mapped V3F auxiliary window-mean softmax probability; threshold fitted on calibration, not a published decision rule; P6 has no PAC decision score so PAC is unrepresented in its comparator
candidate: deterministic L2 logistic head on released P6 and P8 class scores and six V3F auxiliary scores; no backbone changes
